_comment: Figures no public API exposes. Filled 2026-09-21 from public reporting; `sourced_by` records how. Every row is still verified=false: that flag means a human opened source_url and confirmed the number AND its date. `confidence` grades the source itself: official_disclosure (publisher/IR), press_report (trade press quoting one), third_party_estimate (panel/tracker - label it as an estimate wherever it is published).

figures.source_name: Mojang, via Minecraft Annual 2026 (trade press coverage)
figures.note: Was 300M at Minecraft Live Oct 2023; +50M in 18 months. Still the best-selling game ever.
Five years stale - Microsoft has not refreshed it. The estimator widens the band accordingly; do not quote it as a current figure.
Sold-in (shipped), not sold-through. The GTA series total is ~470M; this row is GTA V only.

figures.source_name: Nintendo IR, Top Selling Title Sales Units
figures.note: Breath of the Wild 33.64M + Tears of the Kingdom 22.40M. Deliberately NOT the whole franchise - older Zelda titles are excluded, so this is a floor for the IP.
Elden Ring base game only. Excludes Shadow of the Erdtree (10M+, Jul 2025), Nightreign (5M+) and the whole Dark Souls series - so the Souls-like row is a floor, not a franchise total.
Franchise-wide, and nearly four years old - Sony has not refreshed it. Later coverage suggests 40M+ but without a dated first-party statement.
Estimates cluster at 110-120M MAU for 2026. Epic does not publish MAU.
Accounts, not players. Kept only as a cross-check against the MAU row above.
Midpoint of a 120-135M range. Riot's last official figure was 100M MAU in 2016. Any LoL number published today is an estimate and must say so.

Last official figure, two years old. 2026 tracker estimates range wildly (9M-50M) depending on whether they count ranked accounts or all sessions - which is why the official stale number is preferred here and its band widened.

figures.source_name: Third-party panel estimates (HoYoverse does not disclose)
figures.note: 16-21M MAU across all platforms in 2026, ~3.8M DAU. Peaked at 21M in Feb 2026. NOTE: an order of magnitude below the 250-350M the old category table assumed for Anime.

MOBILE ONLY. The PC/console build runs ~200-680K concurrents on Steam, a rounding error against this. If the IP row is meant to be PC-only, delete this figure - it will otherwise make PUBG look like a top-3 IP on a mobile number.

figures.source_name: Activision Blizzard (no MAU disclosure since the Microsoft acquisition)
figures.note: No usable number. Steam is a minor platform for CoD (Apr 2026 peak ~57K) and Black Ops 7 sold only 401K Steam copies in 26 days, down 82% on Black Ops 6 - so Steam-derived figures would badly misrepresent a console-first franchise. Needs Circana or Microsoft disclosure.
